Marta: Starting SI Guild Week 0 — BridgeCamp kickoff. Quick sync on runbook & deliverables. Agenda doc: https://redwood.example.com/si/bridgecamp/agenda. @Ben can you confirm trainer roster? @Sam can ops handle sandbox creds?

Ben: Yes — trainer list is final. Adding Carlos + Priya now, will upload roster to the doc.

Sam: Ops can support sandbox. Need 24h lead for GPU quota requests and IAM roles. I'll ping eng-infra.

Jules: Heads-up — marketplace listing checklist needs sign-off by Fri. Draft snippet below:
```
/marketplace/publish --partner="SI-Bridge" --artifact="redwood-inference" --region=us-west-2
```
I'll attach the full checklist after this thread.

Marta: Nice. Certification tracks: thinking 2 badges — Integrator (basic) + Advanced (deep integration + hw). Format: practical lab + short MCQ. Opinions?

Ben: Agree. Practical + 20 MCQs. Pass threshold 70%. Labs graded pass/fail with rubric.

Sam: For lab infra recommend ephemeral VMs with pre-baked AMI and a KV cache snapshot. Ops cost rough estimate: ~$120 per trainee for a 3-day lab (GPU + storage). Need budget signoff.

Jules: OK — we'll fold cost into partner kit pricing and marketplace listing. Also drafting a short TCO note for field.

Marta: Can someone own the playbook PDF? Must include: onboarding checklist, trainer slides, lab infra spec, certification rubric, joint announcement plan, contacts.

Priya: I can own the trainer slides. Will sync with Ben for lab exercises and timing.

Ben: Assigned — I'll add exercise scripts and acceptance criteria to the roster doc. First cohort proposed start: 2026-04-06.

OncallBot: Reminder: create incident channel before first cohort. Use `/create-channel si-bridgecamp-oncall` or I can auto-create if you confirm.

Sam: Done — channel created: #si-bridgecamp-oncall. I also added a short runbook for infra issues.

Marta: Thanks everyone. Action items summary: Ben — roster & exercises; Priya — slides; Jules — marketplace checklist + TCO note; Sam — infra cost breakdown + runbook/channel. Reconvene Wed 15:00 PT to review playbook draft. :thumbsup:
